en: The front shows a colorized photographic collage featuring a garden with mushroom-shaped seating and tables, surrounded by trees and foliage. There's a secondary inset image on the upper right which features a building with large windows and a statue in front. The reverse side includes handwritten German text, a green postage stamp, several postal marks including references to 'BAD PYRMONT' and 'Museum im Schloss', and printed information about a 'Gebirgsausflugsort Sennhütte-Burgwaldhof' near Bad Pyrmont, situated by the Bornberg.
